name: guest-place-monorepo
description: Guest Place Monorepo (Rust Axum + Vue Microfrontends + Nuxt Client)

scripts.dev:client:docker: docker compose up -d db redis server admin-panel && cd client && pnpm dev
scripts.dev:admin: docker compose up -d db redis server && cd admin-panel && pnpm dev:all
scripts.dev:server: docker compose up -d db redis && cd server && cargo watch -x run
scripts.generate:api: cargo run --manifest-path server/Cargo.toml --bin guest-place -- --export-openapi && cd admin-panel && pnpm generate:api
scripts.docker:up:deps: docker compose up -d db redis server admin-panel

author: miirsery
